title: wb migrate cannot carry the hv board's standing directives, which have no item kind
body:
The hypervisor node's `## Standing directives` section is part of the whiteboard protocol (the `in-whiteboard` skill: durable instructions every node honours, read at pickup like decisions), but the board model has no item kind for it, so `intent wb migrate hv` leaves every standing directive uncarried. Found on Laksa's cutover (2026-09-14, laksa-vc): hv/wip.md's seven standing directives, its maintained-by note and its READ-THIS section were all reported uncarried and survive only in the verbatim `.history/` copy. laksa-vc proposes restoring them as decisions by hand, which loses the distinction the protocol draws.

Candidates, none ruled: a `directive` item kind carried and rendered under its own heading on the hv board only; or migrate carrying that section's lines as decisions with a marker; or the protocol dropping the section in favour of decisions on hv's board. Whichever is ruled, the skill text and the model must agree.
